assumptions: Stripe subscriptions and expanded customers are read only through Tin's payments.stripe connection.
Paid tenure begins at trial_end when later than subscription start; trials do not count.
Current active and past-due subscription chains meeting retention_days are candidate signals only; they do not prove customer success or consent.
Model output selects only predefined question and angle IDs. Offline fake model responses, including unusable results, are exercised in tests/test_content_customer_proof.py.
cost_drivers: At most eight bounded Stripe reads and one managed gpt-6-luna call. Provider and model costs are governed by their existing Tin contracts.
Model input contains sanitized indexed billing facts only; it excludes customer names, email addresses, Stripe IDs, domains, product summary text, and metadata.
effects: Read-only payments.stripe subscriptions.list calls through the project's restricted Stripe connection.
One Markdown artifact at reports/content/CUSTOMER_PROOF.md, using the fixed-path workflow.code artifact contract.
No customer contact, provider mutation, publishing, or workflow starts.

cases.description: A current work-domain customer with sufficient paid tenure is listed as a candidate. The report must label test-mode evidence and state that tenure does not establish success or permission.
A subscription old enough by creation date but with a recent trial_end has less than the paid-tenure threshold and must not be selected.

contains: No candidates met the selection rule

cases.description: Only personal-email and excluded-domain accounts are present. No candidate or interview recommendation may be produced.
More subscriptions remain after eight pages. The report must say coverage is incomplete and identify the call limit.

The offline test supplies unknown candidate/question/angle IDs, unexpected fields, and malformed model data and verifies deterministic safe-template fallback. This qualification case checks the resulting report's invariant interpretation; qualification inputs do not inject a model response.

rubric.question: Are full emails, customer names, Stripe IDs and unrestricted metadata absent from the model payload and report?
Does the report describe paid tenure only as a candidate signal and avoid success, attribution, outcome or consent claims?
Does the report disclose fitted pages and any incomplete read caused by the eight-call cap?
